$schema: Radio identity (bible §15) + the Radio Tower Network. Stations marked inBuild:true exist in vendor/audio.js today. Towers are fictionalized from real Mumbai transmitter sites (S0 grounding: worldradiomap.com/in/mumbai — the 300m Worli Doordarshan lattice tower carries nearly the whole commercial FM dial; community stations transmit from their own neighborhood masts).

stations.name: Bambaiya FM
stations.flavor: city mainstream; carries the case's news bulletins

stations.name: Bambai Traffic Radio
stations.flavor: live traffic; chase and route coverage

stations.name: Bambai After Dark
stations.flavor: NEW (bible §15): late-night confessional hour; night-act atmosphere

towers.name: Varli Prasarayan Tower
towers.realReferent: 300 m red-white Worli Doordarshan lattice tower (19.007N 72.820E) — Radio City 91.1, Mirchi 98.3, Red FM 93.5, Big FM 92.7, AIR FM Gold/Rainbow/Vividh Bharati, Fever 104, Ishq 104.8, Radio One 94.3, Nasha 91.9, Magic 106.4
towers.zone: north edge Zone A / Zone B
towers.mapRole: master skyline landmark + navigation beacon; tower service rooms = evidence/interior spaces

towers.name: Koliwada Community Mast
towers.realReferent: Chembur college transmitter (90.0 Acharya FM pattern)
towers.mapRole: low-power community station; harbour-community voice; pirate-broadcast site after The Burning Press (Ch9)

towers.name: Bandar West Union Park Mast
towers.realReferent: Khar West Union Park transmitter (90.8 Jago Mumbai pattern)

towers.name: Kalyan Campus Mast
towers.realReferent: Mumbai University Kalyan campus transmitter (107.8 pattern)
towers.mapRole: far-suburb station; the contamination story leaks here (Ch12-14)

towers.name: Malad Transmitter Site
towers.realReferent: AIR high-power MW transmitter (1044 kHz DRM)
towers.mapRole: night long-wave; 'the signal that reaches the whole coast'

bulletinHooks.act1: First reports of the Salvi case; 'developer's consultant found dead' framing; peg-truck item after Ch6.
bulletinHooks.act2: Case-withdrawal coverage (Ch10); Leela's shop fire (Ch9) — stations go quiet, then the Koliwada mast goes pirate.
bulletinHooks.act3: Stay-order coverage (Ch11); contamination briefs leak via the Kalyan campus mast.
bulletinHooks.act4: Internal-affairs leaks; Vinyl Night citywide finale on the Mother Tower.

discoveryActivity: Visiting a mast site unlocks its station lore + district traffic-report coverage (bible §13 'Radio station discovery').
